claims.text: A new NLI test set was created where test sentences differ by at most one word from training set sentences.
NLI systems trained on SNLI perform substantially worse on the new simple lexical inference test set.
State-of-the-art NLI systems fail to capture simple inferences requiring lexical and world knowledge.

evidence.description: Performance on the new test set is substantially worse across systems trained on SNLI.
State-of-the-art models demonstrate limited generalization ability on examples differing by at most one word from training data.

methodologies.name: Lexical Inference NLI Dataset Construction
methodologies.description: Constructed a targeted NLI test set containing minimal variation (at most one word difference) from SNLI training sentences.
conditions: Test sentences differ by at most one word from training set sentences

limitations.text: State-of-the-art NLI systems trained on SNLI are limited in their generalization ability and fail to capture simple lexical and world knowledge inferences.
